name: regenerate
title: Regenerate minutes
description: Bring a meeting's minutes up to date as a background job (kind `regenerate`). Preprocessing, transcription and diarization run idempotently first: each is skipped when its recorded input hashes and parameters are unchanged and only runs when it never ran (a meeting stopped with auto_process=false, a process job that failed) or when set_meeting_config changed its parameters (transcription_engine, transcription_model, diarization_engine, language, vocab_hints). Then alignment → LLM integration → minutes generation run with the same idempotency: a new minutes version is appended only when something changed — existing versions are never overwritten. An explicit minutes_model applies only to text minutes and is part of the generation cache key, including its provider, connection ID/revision, model ID, parameters and cache_epoch. Unchanged inputs and selection reuse the existing version. Changing only this selection does not rerun transcription or LLM integration and never silently substitutes a provider or model. Use it after set_meeting_config or register_context, to process a meeting stopped with auto_process=false, or to retry a failed process job. When both minutes_model and transcription_model are null, `force=true` re-runs alignment, integration and generation even when their inputs are unchanged (still appending a new version); preprocessing and transcription are never forced. When either minutes_model or transcription_model is selected, `force=true` is rejected with invalid_argument. To explicitly start a new selected-model attempt, confirm retransmission with the user, save an incremented minutes_model.cache_epoch through set_meeting_config, and call regenerate with the returned config as expected_config, a new request_id and force=false. A previous unknown selected-model generation outcome is never automatically resent; ordinary regeneration with the same selection cannot bypass its receipt. `reason` is recorded in manifest.regenerations. `scope` is the scope selector (default deny: a scoped meeting needs its scope in the request). When the saved minutes_model or transcription_model is non-null, expected_config is required and must be the full effective config confirmed by the caller. Any supplied expected_config is compared with the current config under the meeting lock before changes or job creation; a mismatch returns configuration_conflict without sending or generating. `request_id` is the client-generated idempotency key: repeating the call returns the same job_id. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: not_found (unknown meeting), scope_denied (the request does not cover the meeting's scope), busy (the meeting is still recording, or a job is already queued / running for it), policy_violation (the configured transcription_model, minutes_model, llm_provider or engines are not allowed by external_send_policy — nothing is silently downgraded), engine_unavailable (configured engine / provider not installed), configuration_conflict, authentication_required, model_unavailable, invalid_argument, internal. Failures inside the job are reported by get_job_status. API transcription reuses verified successful chunks regardless of cache_epoch; changing only the epoch does not replace completed transcripts or change downstream fingerprints. Audio is split deterministically into nonoverlapping chunks of at most 9600000 samples at 16000 Hz, processed sequentially mic then system, at most 144 chunks and 24 total audio hours. A transcription_retry is one explicit user confirmation to retransmit a single outcome-unknown chunk, not a saved setting. It requires expected_config with a non-null transcription_model, force=false and selected cache_epoch greater than blocked_epoch. Before any ASR send, compare the full config, actual input/chunk fingerprints and latest blocked epoch; reject mismatch without sending. Persist the new pending epoch before sending, consume that confirmation once, reuse successes and never implicitly retry other unknown chunks. Retry, restart, elapsed time, selection clear/restore and ordinary epoch changes do not erase unknown outcomes. Confirmation details come from get_job_status.error.details with reason=transcription_outcome_unknown. Initial API transcription sends no vocabulary prompt or speaker reference audio. Cancellation after sending cannot guarantee provider-side processing or billing has stopped.

expected_config.description: Full effective config confirmed by the caller, as returned by get_meeting. Required when saved minutes_model or transcription_model is non-null, and always with transcription_retry. Compare under the meeting lock before enqueueing; mismatch returns configuration_conflict without sending. Omission for legacy state is decided by the server.

force.description: Default false. Only when minutes_model and transcription_model are null may true re-run stages from alignment. API transcription and selected minutes models reject true. For an unknown ASR chunk, both a higher transcription cache_epoch and matching one-chunk transcription_retry confirmation are required; successful chunks are never forced.

reason.description: Free-text reason recorded in manifest.regenerations (e.g. "added Notion transcript").

job_id.description: The enqueued regenerate job; poll with get_job_status.
